enabled.description: Whether to enable LLDP globally on the system

sysname.description: System name to advertise via LLDP (defaults to hostname if empty)

system_description.description: System description string to advertise (e.g., OS and version)

port_description.description: Default port description to use on interfaces that don’t have one

tx_hold.description: Number of tx-interval periods to hold LLDPDU before expiration

management_addresses.description: List of IP addresses to advertise as management addresses

version.description: IP version: 4 for IPv4, 6 for IPv6

address.description: IP address in dotted-decimal (IPv4) or colon-hex (IPv6) notation

interfaces.description: Per-interface LLDP configuration (e.g., to enable/disable LLDP selectively)

enabled.description: Whether LLDP is enabled on this interface

description.description: Interface-specific LLDP port description (overrides global port-description)

snmp_community.description: SNMP read-only community string for LLDP-MIB access (optional)

chassis_id.description: Override the automatically derived chassis ID (e.g., 'mac:00:11:22:33:44:55' or 'chassis:00:11:22:33:44:55')
